name: 7k-design-system
description: Dark, neon-accented, manga-inflected design system for multi-project tech company 7K. Three-font system (Geist sans + Geist Mono + Geist Pixel 5 geometric variants), #FF0FF brand pulse, Tokyo neon atmosphere with 1-bit manga punctuation.

scripts.build: cp colors_and_type.css dist/7k-design-system.css && cp -r fonts dist/ && cp -r build dist/ && cp -r preview dist/
scripts.test: echo 'Open dist/test-isolation.html in a browser to verify'

author: 7K
